recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, high-contrast portrait of a man in a cowboy hat, where the brim casts a deep shadow over his eyes. The subject is wearing a textured denim shirt, and the composition is anchored by heavy, western-style slab serif typography at the bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: The brim of the hat creates a diagonal line that bisects the face.
The warm skin tones contrast with the cool, desaturated blue of the denim shirt.
The massive scale of the typography at the base creates a solid foundation for the image.
coreInvariants: Stacked typography in the lower third

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Extreme close-up, head and shoulders, filling the frame from top to bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, bold display text at the bottom edge.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bright crown of the hat, moves down the diagonal shadow to the mouth/chin, and settles on the heavy text at the base.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the subject and text occupy nearly 90% of the frame.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm beige and cream (hat and skin highlights).
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep charcoal and indigo (shadows and denim shirt).
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted gold/tan (used in specific letters of the typography).
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast with desaturated mid-tones; highlights are blown out while shadows are crushed.

letterConstructionRules: Sharp, thorn-like spurs protruding from the center of vertical stems
Heavy, blocky serifs with slight internal curves
characterSpecificRedesigns: Spurs added to the mid-section of 'J', 'U', 'S', 'T', 'I', 'N', 'M', 'O', 'R', 'E'
Alternating fill colors between cream and tan for specific words
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Varying scales of the same slab-serif family to create a cohesive 'frontier' aesthetic.
graphicDevices: Color blocking within the text string

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the western spur-serif aesthetic perfectly.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A close-up photograph of a man in a light-colored cowboy hat and a grey denim snap-button shirt. The hat brim should cast a dark shadow over the top half of his face, leaving only the nose, mouth, and stubbled chin visible. High contrast lighting with a dark, indistinct background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, ultra-condensed western slab-serif text across the bottom. The main name should be in cream and tan with decorative spurs on the stems. Stack a smaller three-line title in the bottom right corner using a similar slab-serif font.

verificationChecks: Is the hat brim shadow obscuring the eyes?
Does the denim shirt have visible stitching and snap buttons?
Is the main text vertically elongated with spurs?
Is the color palette restricted to cream, tan, and indigo?

adjustableVariables: Specific placement of the spurs on the letters
mustRedesign: Any specific artist names or trademarked logos
Unique facial features of the specific individual

mustAchieve: Tactile texture in the denim and skin
Strong geometric presence in the typography

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text is legible against the shirt texture.
Check that the hat shadow does not look muddy or noisy.
Verify the spurs on the letters are sharp and consistent.
Confirm the composition feels 'bottom-heavy' due to the text.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-contrast 'shadowed-eye' cowboy portrait with ultra-condensed, spurred western slab-serif typography anchored at the base.
